annotations.title: Send a studio ad or copy into a running ad

description: Put a studio ad (all its sizes: the creative ids of one ad) or ad texts written by Taseli's studio into a RUNNING ad, as one proposal the owner approves in Taseli (nothing changes before that). Without `kind`, lists where it fits: Meta ad sets (a new ad with the ad set's own link and button), Performance Max asset groups (pictures, videos and headlines/long headlines/descriptions added as assets, within the group's room), Demand Gen ad groups (a new image or video ad copying the group's logo, name, button and page), TikTok ad groups (a new ad next to the busiest one, created off; once TikTok approves it the owner is asked to turn it on, then it's compared for a week), and, with copy, live search ads (new lines into free slots, then over weak ones; never a pinned line). Read-only accounts are never sent to. Google checks every change first (validate only).

account_id.description: The Taseli ad account id, as the list says.

creative_ids.description: The library creatives of ONE ad (its sizes, ≤ 8), or every card of one carousel (both shapes).

kind.description: Where, as the list says; omit to list the places.

meta_words.description: meta_ad: keep the ad set's live words (default), or new words: primary_texts / headlines / descriptions when given (checked against Meta's limits), else written now for the picture. Several options go as Meta's multiple text options when the ad set takes them (Meta checks first), else one. A carousel uses its own words unless keep.

primary_texts.description: meta_ad with meta_words new: primary texts (≤ 125); headlines (≤ 40) and descriptions (≤ 30) then count as Meta's.

target_id.description: The place's id, as the list says.

tiktok_text.description: TikTok ad text (12-100, no links, @ or #); omit to keep the source ad's.

name: send_to_ad

error.description: Why nothing was done, as a short code.

note.description: A plain note instead of data (nothing connected yet, not available here).
